note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners. Story sections use h2 headings (Product & Platform, Industry & Infrastructure, AI & Society). Sign-off + Share button at the end. Sponsor slots use advertisementOpportunity nodes labeled 'A WORD FROM OUR SPONSOR' only when offers/agreements exist.
established_template.ad_placement: One ad after the intro (top); two ads near the bottom separated by the sign-off (before sign-off + after sign-off, before the Share button) so they are never stacked.

ad_nodes.note: OMIT data-advertisement-kind to let beehiiv auto-select the creative. Setting data-advertisement-kind="primary" was REJECTED on 2026-06-20 for offers whose primary (with-logo) creative was unavailable ('No primary ad slot is available'). Auto-select is the safe default for unattended runs.
